# differential test (scripts/testdata/oracle_differential.py). Never part of sfr or a release.
# Install, outside the repository: python3 -m venv ~/sfr-venv &&
#   ~/sfr-venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r scripts/testdata/requirements-dev.txt
# then SFR_ORACLE_PYTHON=~/sfr-venv/bin/python scripts/validate.sh
